scores.evidence: Three can-do objectives, each with 3+ questions and at least one at apply level (o1: q2, q3, e1, e2; o2: q1, q6, e3, e4; o3: q4, q5, e5, e6). But q5 (fork vs ordinary subagent vs /clear vs skill) is a choose-the-tool item tagged o3, 「コンテキストが節約できる理由を説明できる」, which it does not test.

hook-b1 states a concrete problem in 3 sentences (「毎回同じ手順をClaude Codeに貼り付けていませんか」), and hook-predict asks an ungraded prediction that leads into 7-1. The prediction is closer to recall of lesson 6 (CLAUDE.md is loaded in full every session), and it does not touch the second problem the lead raises (research output flooding the conversation).

Prerequisites are listed, earlier lessons are recalled (「（第6回）」 in hook-q, 「（第5回）」 in s3-lead), and the new terms are defined in s1-defs and s3-defs with English on first use, matching the glossary. A few words are used without a definition: 「YAMLで書きます」 in s1-defs and 「トークン」 in the e5 explanation.

Lint shows 0 budget warnings and every segment has a diagram, table or check. But estMinutes is 21, above the contract's 8–20, and section 7-3 packs five ideas into one segment (subagent, fork, Explore, background default with /tasks, and the .claude/agents/ file with the /agents removal).

s2-steps is a 6-step worked example with subgoal labels and most of the reasons (②「Claudeは説明文で使うかを決めるので」, ⑤「Claudeの判断を待たずに」), and it comes before practice. ① does not say why the folder must exist before starting Claude Code, and the subagent half of the practice (/context before and after) has no demonstration beforehand.

Every content section ends with an inline quiz (s1-check, s2-check, s3-check, s4-check) that includes apply and analyze items, with feedback on every wrong option. But q3 can be answered by matching words: option b is the only option written as 「何をするか＋いつ使うか」, which ex-description taught just before, and it is twice as long as the others.

All seven misconceptions in the brief appear as distractors, each with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer that corrects it: q1 a (skills fully loaded), q2 b (「勝手に使わないこと」 in description), q4 a/c (everything or nothing returns), q5 b (subagent remembers), q6 d and s4-pitfall (install everything first), e2 a (more detailed body), e4 (long procedure stays in CLAUDE.md).

Two process diagrams of 5–6 nodes, with labels in the lesson's own terms (「名前と説明文だけ読み込む」, 「要約だけ」). Each caption states the takeaway (「スキルの本文は、使うときだけコンテキストに入る」), each has a descriptive alt, and there are no decorative images.

An authentic transfer task (the learner's own repeated procedure turned into a skill, then a /context before-and-after) with expect on every step, hints and troubleshoot, a pr-checklist self-check and a model answer in pr-model. But the rule pr-decide gives for disable-model-invocation (「ファイルの書きかえやコミットを含むなら」) and pr-model-lead's reason (「ファイルを書きかえるので」) contradict the rule taught in s2-invoke (「取り消しにくい手順」), and pr-c3 grades the learner on it.

summary-points (4 points) comes after the exam. summary-next has a reflection question (「この1週間で2回以上同じ説明をした作業は、どこに置くとよいでしょう」) and the next step (第8回), followed by 6 flashcards and askTutor suggestions.

Behaviour claims are cited to official sources and the version is pinned (v2.1.304, v2.1.198). But the fallback in s2-terminal breaks the worked example: after 「mkdir cc-practice && cd cc-practice && git init」 the next line 「cd cc-practice」 fails, and the fresh repo has no commit or file, so step ④ (「ファイルを少し変えてから」) has nothing to change and the skill's `git diff HEAD` fails with an unknown-revision error.

です・ます throughout, warm and without pressure (「練習用フォルダで進めましょう」), no banned phrases, and terms are consistent (説明文／description, メインの会話, まっさら). A few spots are slightly casual or stiff, e.g. 「それに、スキルの本文も…」 in the e3 feedback; the ja-editor owns the wording.
Single locale jp, complete; diagram labels are in Japanese with descriptive alt text. The only link has descriptive text (「公式ドキュメント（日本語版）」).

mustFix.issue: The fallback in the code comment breaks the worked example. If the learner runs 「mkdir cc-practice && cd cc-practice && git init」, the next line 「cd cc-practice」 fails because they are already inside that folder. The new repo also has no commit and no file, so in step ④ there is nothing to 「少し変えて」, and the skill's `git diff HEAD` fails (HEAD does not exist yet). The brief's Assumptions put this case in a troubleshoot with a first commit.
mustFix.fix: Delete the comment line, so s2-terminal is only `cd cc-practice` and `mkdir -p .claude/skills/commit-message`. Add to step ex-folder: "troubleshoot": "`cc-practice` がないときは、`mkdir cc-practice && cd cc-practice && git init` で作ります。READMEなどのファイルを1つ作って最初のコミットをしてから、`mkdir -p .claude/skills/commit-message` を実行します。"

mustFix.issue: q5 asks the learner to choose a tool (fork / ordinary subagent / /clear / skill) for a side task that needs the conversation history. It does not ask why a subagent saves the main context, yet it is tagged objectiveId o3 (「コンテキストが節約できる理由を説明できる」) with bloom analyze.
mustFix.fix: In q5 set "objectiveId": "o2" and "bloom": "apply": it tests the choice among skill, subagent and conversation tools. o3 stays assessed by q4, e5 and e6.

mustFix.issue: q3 gives its answer away. Option b is the only option written in the 「何をするか。いつ使うか。」 form that ex-description stated just before, and it is about twice as long as the others; a ('テスト用') and c ('とても大事なスキルです') are throwaways. A learner can answer by matching words without judging what makes a description useful.
mustFix.fix: Replace option a with a near-miss that has the what but not the when: {"id": "a", "md": "テストを実行し、失敗したものだけを一覧にまとめるスキル。", "feedback": "何をするかはわかりますが、いつ使うかがありません。Claudeは依頼と見比べるので、使う場面も書きます。"}. Shorten option b to "テストを実行し、失敗をまとめる。テスト結果を聞かれたときや、コードを変えた後に使う。" so the lengths are parallel.

mustFix.issue: The decision rule for disable-model-invocation is inconsistent. s2-invoke teaches it for 「コミットやデプロイなど取り消しにくい手順」, but pr-decide says 「ファイルの書きかえやコミットを含むなら」 and pr-model-lead says 「ファイルを書きかえるので」. By that rule almost every skill that edits files would be user-only. pr-c3 then grades the learner on a rule the lesson did not teach.
mustFix.fix: Use one rule in all three places, matching cc-skills (side effects, or you want to control the timing). s2-invoke md: "この例はコミットしません。コミットやデプロイのように取り消しにくい手順や、動かす時期を自分で決めたい手順もあります。そうした手順には、`disable-model-invocation: true` を足します。`/名前` で呼んだときだけ動き、説明文もコンテキストに入りません。" pr-decide md: "コミットのように取り消しにくい操作を含むか、動かす時期を自分で決めたいかを考えます。当てはまれば、`disable-model-invocation: true` を足します。" pr-model-lead md: "模範解答の例です。`disable-model-invocation: true` を付けています。READMEを直す時期を、自分で決めたいからです。"

mustFix.issue: estMinutes is 21, above the contract's limit for one lesson (8–20 minutes). The brief's own estimate is about 8.0 min reading + 13 questions × 40 s (about 8.7 min) + 2 tasks × 2 min, which is about 20.7 min.
mustFix.fix: Delete exam question e4 from check-quiz. Its point (move a long, rarely used procedure from CLAUDE.md to a skill) is already assessed by q6 and e1 option c, and o2 stays in the exam through e3. Then 12 questions × 40 s = 8.0 min; 8.0 + 8.0 + 4 = 20.0, so set "estMinutes": 20.

niceToHave: s3-defs (fork), q5, card-fork, s3-bg and pr-test cite cc-commands for `/subtask`, `/tasks` and `/reload-skills`. The repo's research notes (doc/brushup-2026/research/claude-code-curriculum.ja.md) confirm only `/tasks` and the v2.1.198 changes, not `/subtask` or `/reload-skills`. Re-check both on the commands page for v2.1.304 before publishing.
ex-folder: give the reason for the order, for example add "セッションの途中で作ったスキルのフォルダは、`/reload-skills` するまで読み込まれないためです。" (cite cc-skills / cc-commands).
pr-terminal hard-codes `update-readme`, while pr-pick asks for the learner's own task. In pr-write, say "上のコマンドの `update-readme` は、自分のスキル名に変えます。"

Section 7-3 carries five ideas. s3-bg (background default and /tasks) already appears as the hint of pr-delegate, so it could be removed from the segment to keep 7-3 on 'own context, only the summary returns' plus fork.

The subagent half of the practice (⑤–⑦, /context before and after) has no demonstration. One sentence in s3-how describing what the learner will see (the request and the short report added, not the files read) would act as a minimal worked example.
hook-predict: options b and c have no feedback (the quiz is ungraded, so lint does not require it). One sentence each would correct 「関係ないと判断して読み飛ばす」 directly.

o1 has bloom create, but the selected-response items are apply/analyze. Consider tagging pr-checklist items against o1, or lowering o1's bloom to apply in the brief and objective, so the stated level matches what is checked.
e5: option a is noticeably longer than b–d. Trim it to "読んだ中身はサブエージェント側に残り、メインには要約だけが戻るから" to keep the lengths parallel.
s1-defs: "YAMLで書きます" is the only undefined technical term in the segment. Consider "YAML（設定を書くための書き方の一つ）で書きます". The e5 explanation uses 「トークン」 without a recall of where it was defined.
summary: The biggest strength is how the misconceptions are handled: all seven from the brief appear as distractors with short corrective feedback, the two process diagrams have clear takeaway captions, and there is a solid 6-step worked example before an authentic practice task with a checklist and model answer. The most important fixes are the broken fallback path in s2-terminal (a fresh repo with no commit makes the worked example fail), the contradictory disable-model-invocation rule between s2-invoke and the practice, q3 giving its answer away, q5 tagged to the wrong objective, and estMinutes 21 being above the 20-minute limit.
